# The Ridge Mashobra, Shimla

> Domain: https://mashobrashimla.com
> Business Model: Independent Real Estate Brokerage / Property Consultancy / Lead Generation
> Primary Location: Mashobra, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, India

## Overview
The Ridge Mashobra (mashobrashimla.com) is an independent real estate consultancy portal dedicated to luxury residential real estate, mountain villas, 3 BHK and 4 BHK holiday homes, and second home investments across Mashobra, Shimla, Kufri, and Naldehra in Himachal Pradesh.

We assist discerning homebuyers, families, and property investors with factual project insights, verified developer coordination, Section 118 statutory guidance, private site visit bookings, and end-to-end documentation advisory.

## Location Coverage
- Mashobra, Shimla (Primary focus: Altitude 2,100m, pine & deodar belt)
- Shimla (Capital hub: British colonial heritage, Mall Road, urban conveniences)
- Kufri (Alpine elevation: 2,622m, heavy winter snowfalls, meadows)
- Naldehra (Historic 9-hole golf course, serene cedar forests)

## Key Property Categories
- Luxury Villas in Mashobra (3 BHK & 4 BHK independent mountain villas)
- Second Homes in Himachal Pradesh (Tranquil wellness and weekend retreats)
- Holiday Homes near Shimla (Scenic vacation properties with rental yield potential)
- The Ridge Mashobra Project (Contemporary residences with Himalayan valley vistas)

1. Independent Consultancy: mashobrashimla.com is an independent property marketing and consultancy portal. We are NOT the official developer website of The Ridge Mashobra or any affiliated builder.
2. No Online Bookings or Payments: We never accept financial bookings or token amounts directly on this website. All financial transactions must be verified directly with authorized developer accounts.
